workflow.critical: All report CONTENT must be in {reporting_language}
Execute ALL steps in exact order — do NOT skip steps

step.goal: Resolve suite name from argument or active suite in test-suites.yml

check.if: no suite name argument is provided
file does not exist or active_suite is empty
check.output: ❌ No active suite found. Run /aiqa-analyzestory --suite <name> first, then retry.

step.action: Read TestResult/test-suites.yml and find the suite entry where name = {suite_name}

check.output: ❌ Suite "{suite_name}" not found in TestResult/test-suites.yml. Run /aiqa-analyzestory --suite {suite_name} first to register it.

step.goal: Verify suite has reached the minimum required status

check.output: ❌ Suite "{suite_name}" has not been tested yet. Current status : {current_status} Required status : tests-executed (minimum) Run /aiqa-runtests first to execute the tests before generating a report.

step.action: Generates: - HTML dashboard: {output_folder}/{story_id}/reports/qa-report.html - XLSX summary: {output_folder}/{story_id}/reports/qa-report.xlsx - MD summary: {output_folder}/{story_id}/reports/qa-report.md

check.output: ❌ FAILED — Pass rate below quality gate. Review bug reports at: {output_folder}/{story_id}/bug-reports/

step.goal: Self-review — verify report completeness and accuracy

artifact-checklist.file: HTML dashboard — must exist and contain test results table
XLSX summary — must exist with at least one data sheet
Markdown summary — must exist and contain pass rate and bug summary

quality-checklist.check: All 3 report files exist at the correct paths
Pass rate in the report matches the actual test execution results — not a placeholder value
Bug count in the report matches the number of files in {output_folder}/{story_id}/bug-reports/
All test results (passed and failed) are listed in the report — no tests omitted
Report language is {reporting_language} — all headings, labels, and content use the correct language
HTML report renders valid HTML (opening and closing tags balanced, no broken structure)
MD report contains: executive summary, pass rate, failed test list, bug severity breakdown, and next recommended actions
Quality gate result (PASSED / FAILED) is clearly stated in all three report formats

review.fix-if-needed: For every failed check, apply the fix before marking this step complete: - QR-1 → re-run generate-report skill for any missing file - QR-2/QR-3 → re-read test results and bug-reports folder; recalculate and update figures - QR-4 → add all missing test results to the report - QR-5 → translate or correct all content to {reporting_language} - QR-6 → fix broken HTML structure - QR-7 → add missing MD sections - QR-8 → add quality gate result prominently to all formats After all fixes, re-read the reports and confirm all checks pass.

step.output: ✅ Review complete — all 3 report files verified: pass rate accurate, bug count consistent, language correct

step.action: Update the entry: - phases.generate-report: done - status: if current rank < rank("report-generated") → set to "report-generated"; otherwise keep existing (never downgrade) - updated: {current_date}
Write the updated content back to TestResult/test-suites.yml
step.output:
📋 test-suites.yml updated — suite "{suite_name}" → report-generated
🏁 All phases complete for suite "{suite_name}".
